texts.label: text
texts.orig: Project Title: Local Smart Notebook: A Multi-Agent Local Knowledge & Analytics Platform
texts.text: Project Title: Local Smart Notebook: A Multi-Agent Local Knowledge & Analytics Platform

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Target Domain: Local Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Autonomous AI Agents, Data Science Automation
texts.text: Target Domain: Local Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Autonomous AI Agents, Data Science Automation

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Abstract:
texts.text: Abstract:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Local Smart Notebook is an open-source, fully offline, privacy-first alternative to cloudbased research tools like Google NotebookLM. Designed to run completely on local consumer hardware without sending data to external cloud APIs, Local Smart Notebook enables users to ingest multi-format documents (PDFs, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, TXT), perform contextual multi-document Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), synthesize research summaries, execute code-driven data analytics on Excel spreadsheets, and automatically compile findings into customizable PowerPoint presentations (.pptx), images, graphs, or excel sheets.
texts.text: Local Smart Notebook is an open-source, fully offline, privacy-first alternative to cloudbased research tools like Google NotebookLM. Designed to run completely on local consumer hardware without sending data to external cloud APIs, Local Smart Notebook enables users to ingest multi-format documents (PDFs, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, TXT), perform contextual multi-document Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), synthesize research summaries, execute code-driven data analytics on Excel spreadsheets, and automatically compile findings into customizable PowerPoint presentations (.pptx), images, graphs, or excel sheets.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 2. Problem Statement & Motivation
texts.text: 2. Problem Statement & Motivation

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Cloud-based AI workspaces like Google NotebookLM offer strong analytical capabilities, but they introduce critical limitations for sensitive domains:
texts.text: Cloud-based AI workspaces like Google NotebookLM offer strong analytical capabilities, but they introduce critical limitations for sensitive domains:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1. Data Privacy & Compliance: Healthcare providers, legal teams, financial institutions, and government agencies cannot upload confidential contracts, medical records, or proprietary research to third-party cloud servers.
texts.text: Data Privacy & Compliance: Healthcare providers, legal teams, financial institutions, and government agencies cannot upload confidential contracts, medical records, or proprietary research to third-party cloud servers.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. API Costs & Bandwidth Limitations: Heavy querying across thousands of pages of documentation incurs high token usage costs and requires constant high-speed internet.
texts.text: API Costs & Bandwidth Limitations: Heavy querying across thousands of pages of documentation incurs high token usage costs and requires constant high-speed internet.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3. Lack of Native Data Processing: Existing tools focus primarily on textual Q&A and lack native execution environments to compute complex formulaic operations, filter large dataset files (Excel/CSV), or export native presentation slides.
texts.text: Lack of Native Data Processing: Existing tools focus primarily on textual Q&A and lack native execution environments to compute complex formulaic operations, filter large dataset files (Excel/CSV), or export native presentation slides.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Local Smart Notebook solves these issues by embedding open-source Large Language Models (LLMs), local vector embeddings, and sandboxed Python code execution environments entirely on the user's workstation.
texts.text: Local Smart Notebook solves these issues by embedding open-source Large Language Models (LLMs), local vector embeddings, and sandboxed Python code execution environments entirely on the user's workstation.

texts.orig: 3. Core Features & Technical Feasibility
texts.text: 3. Core Features & Technical Feasibility

texts.label: text
texts.orig: All requested features can be delivered strictly using Python and standard open-source libraries.
texts.text: All requested features can be delivered strictly using Python and standard open-source libraries.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Feature 1: Multi-Document Local RAG Engine
texts.text: Feature 1: Multi-Document Local RAG Engine

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Capability: Ingests dozens of files simultaneously (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, Text, Code files).
texts.text: Capability: Ingests dozens of files simultaneously (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, Text, Code files).

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: · Technical Strategy:
texts.text: · Technical Strategy:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o Parser: Unstructured, PyPDF, or pdfplumber for semantic text chunking.
texts.text: o Parser: Unstructured, PyPDF, or pdfplumber for semantic text chunking.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o Local Embeddings: bge-m3 or nomic-embed-text-v1.5 running locally via HuggingFace sentence-transformers or Ollama.
texts.text: o Local Embeddings: bge-m3 or nomic-embed-text-v1.5 running locally via HuggingFace sentence-transformers or Ollama.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o Vector Database: Qdrant (Embedded local mode) or ChromaDB stored on local disk.
texts.text: o Vector Database: Qdrant (Embedded local mode) or ChromaDB stored on local disk.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o Hybrid Search: Dense vector search combined with BM25 sparse keyword retrieval (Reciprocal Rank Fusion - RRF) to maximize context retrieval accuracy.
texts.text: o Hybrid Search: Dense vector search combined with BM25 sparse keyword retrieval (Reciprocal Rank Fusion - RRF) to maximize context retrieval accuracy.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Feature 2: Automated Summarization & Synthesis Engine
texts.text: Feature 2: Automated Summarization & Synthesis Engine

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Capability: Generates executive summaries, thematic comparisons, study guides, and bulleted briefings across single or combined sources.
texts.text: Capability: Generates executive summaries, thematic comparisons, study guides, and bulleted briefings across single or combined sources.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: · Technical Strategy:
texts.text: · Technical Strategy:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o Uses map-reduce or hierarchical chunk summarization chains managed by local LLMs (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 14B, or DeepSeek-R1-DistillQwen-14B).
texts.text: o Uses map-reduce or hierarchical chunk summarization chains managed by local LLMs (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 14B, or DeepSeek-R1-DistillQwen-14B).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o Enforces structured output formatting (JSON/Markdown schemas) to extract key takeaways, entities, and citations pointing directly to source page numbers.
texts.text: o Enforces structured output formatting (JSON/Markdown schemas) to extract key takeaways, entities, and citations pointing directly to source page numbers.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Feature 3: Automated Presentation Generator (.pptx)
texts.text: Feature 3: Automated Presentation Generator (.pptx)

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Capability: Transforms summarized insights or document collections into fully editable PowerPoint (.pptx) decks.
texts.text: Capability: Transforms summarized insights or document collections into fully editable PowerPoint (.pptx) decks.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: · Technical Strategy:
texts.text: · Technical Strategy:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o An AI agent decomposes the document context into slide outlines: Title, Subtitle, Bullet Points, and Speaker Notes in JSON format.
texts.text: o An AI agent decomposes the document context into slide outlines: Title, Subtitle, Bullet Points, and Speaker Notes in JSON format.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o A custom Python script powered by python-pptx ingests the JSON schema and builds formatted slides using standard templates (Title Slide, 2-Column Comparison, Stat Highlight, Conclusion).
texts.text: o A custom Python script powered by python-pptx ingests the JSON schema and builds formatted slides using standard templates (Title Slide, 2-Column Comparison, Stat Highlight, Conclusion).

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Document Context -> Local Agent -> Structured JSON -> python-pptx -> Downloadable .pptx
texts.text: Document Context -> Local Agent -> Structured JSON -> python-pptx -> Downloadable .pptx

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Feature 4: Spreadsheet Data Analysis Engine (Excel & CSV)
texts.text: Feature 4: Spreadsheet Data Analysis Engine (Excel & CSV)

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Capability: Cleans, filters, aggregates, visualizes, and performs statistical analysis on .xlsx / .csv files via natural language queries.
texts.text: Capability: Cleans, filters, aggregates, visualizes, and performs statistical analysis on .xlsx / .csv files via natural language queries.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: · Technical Strategy:
texts.text: · Technical Strategy:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o Code Interpreter Agent Pattern: Instead of having the LLM guess numeric calculations (which leads to math errors), an agent generates sandboxed Python pandas / openpyxl code.
texts.text: o Code Interpreter Agent Pattern: Instead of having the LLM guess numeric calculations (which leads to math errors), an agent generates sandboxed Python pandas / openpyxl code.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: o The local system executes the generated code on the local dataset and returns the resulting table summary or Matplotlib/Seaborn plot image back to the UI.
texts.text: o The local system executes the generated code on the local dataset and returns the resulting table summary or Matplotlib/Seaborn plot image back to the UI.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Feature 5: Multi-Agent Coordination (Local AI Agents)
texts.text: Feature 5: Multi-Agent Coordination (Local AI Agents)

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Capability: Routes complex queries to specialized sub-agents (e.g., Research Agent, Coding/Data Agent, Slide Builder Agent).
texts.text: Capability: Routes complex queries to specialized sub-agents (e.g., Research Agent, Coding/Data Agent, Slide Builder Agent).

texts.orig: · Technical Strategy:
texts.text: · Technical Strategy:

texts.text: o Built using LangGraph or CrewAI to manage stateful graph execution and tool calling with local models.

texts.text: 4. Recommended Technology Stack

Outstanding instruction- following, structured JSON generation, and function calling.
Native Python support, disk- persistent storage, fast vector indexing.
State machine management for agent execution loops, memory, and tool calls.
Fast array and relational data querying directly in memory.
